title: Compliance onboarding wizard — experimental bundled offer (retention + SLA + security questionnaire)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Run a gated experiment that bundles an opinionated Compliance Pack (questionnaire-driven SKU) with a configurable observability retention tier and an optional premium SLA. The onboarding wizard will map answers from the security questionnaire to a recommended bundle (Compliance Lite / Compliance Plus) and surface a one-click add-on purchase or sales-assist handoff. Goal: reduce sales cycle time for regulated customers, increase attach rate for observability retention add-ons, and quantify lift in mid-market contract TTV (time-to-value) and ARR expansion.
hypothesis: If we present a short security questionnaire during signup and auto-recommend a bundled Compliance Pack (with retention and SLA options) via a focused wizard, more enterprise prospects will self-serve to a paid plan or request help with a higher likelihood than when these features are surfaced separately in the Console or via sales collateral.
metrics: primary: bundle_attach_rate (% of eligible enterprise signups that add bundle)
safeguard: no degradation in hosted API latency or billing accuracy during experiment
acceptance_criteria: Wizard appears for enterprise signups (org size > 50 or SSO-enabled) and completes mapping logic validation
Backend SKU mapping sends correct line items to billing and seat/contact records
UI shows clear retention slider and SLA options with copy explaining cost/benefit
A/B cohort defined: 50% exposed to wizard + bundle recommendation, 50% control (existing flow)
Security review completed and legal-approved contract language for Compliance Plus
proposal: Build a short, 6-question security questionnaire in the onboarding flow that maps to a small rule table. The wizard will produce one of: No Bundle, Compliance Lite (30d retention, standard SLA), Compliance Plus (365d retention, premium SLA 99.9% + quarterly compliance report). Surface estimated monthly delta and link to checklist for security/compliance docs. For sales-assisted flows, create a 'Recommend to sales' flag and pre-populate the account's security answers into the CRM lead note.
design_notes: Create a lightweight modal-first wizard; prioritize clarity over configurability
Retention slider defaults to the least-privileged cost option (30d) with an explicit 'why choose longer retention' tooltip
Add contextual help explaining how retention affects unit cost and incident reconstruction
engineering_notes: Billing: new additive SKU structure required to support per-org retention tiers — implement as metered addon with discrete tiers (30d, 90d, 365d)
Console: flag-based rollout behind feature flag pm/compliance-wizard; A/B assignment handled in growth service
Runtime: ensure that retention routing and KV cache TTLs enforce data access policies; no changes to tokenization or model binaries
Telemetry: emit events wizard_shown, wizard_completed, bundle_added, survey_answers to track funnel
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Billing complexity increases and customers may be charged incorrectly — Mitigation: run end-to-end billing sandbox tests and require sign-off from billing team
Risk: Sales friction if questionnaire wrongly downgrades needs — Mitigation: include 'Recommend to sales' override and visible rationale for recommendation
Risk: Security/legal pushback on canned contract language — Mitigation: engage legal early and ship Compliance Lite first as a low-risk tranche
tasks: PM: finalize questionnaire mapping table and SKU definitions
Design: prototype wizard modal and copy
Eng-Frontend: implement wizard flow, A/B hook, and retention slider UI
Eng-Backend: implement SKU mapping endpoint and billing payloads
Eng-Runtime: validate retention enforcement and add logging hooks
Security: perform architecture review and sign off on dataflow
Legal: draft Compliance Pack contract language and TOS addendum
Growth/Analytics: set up experiment cohorts and dashboards

Include a 'Recommend to sales' CTA that pre-populates the CRM with questionnaire answers
